notes.title: 1.23 Update released!
notes.content: In addition to minor bug fixes, we've added trails back onto the grenades launched from mechs, tankbots, and aerial ships. These really improve their visibility when things are really chaotic. More updates to come!

notes.title: Version 1.22 Update!
notes.content: We just launched the 1.22 update...this is largely a maintenance update which includes bug fixes and some art enhancements. The missiles are a bit larger and more visible now with emissive maps. Grenade explosions are larger and way more satisfying! A few other minor adjustments. More updates to follow! Thanks again for the amazing feedback, and enjoy playing Inbound!

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update...deployable land mines!
notes.content:
In addition to a few minor bug fixes, version 1.2 includes a power-up for land mines! If you are having trouble with mechs and tankbots ruining your day, just deploy a few of these guys near the trouble spots...problem solved! We're looking at adding an automated deployable plasma turret...what do you think?

Also new...the grenades will detonate in the vicinity of ground assault units. Some players reported frustration that well-placed shots would bounce away before detonating. We agree that that is frustrating, so this addresses that issue.

There's also a new "how to play" screen that's cleaner and updated with all of the power-ups.

Keep those suggestions and comments coming! We're going to continue releasing updates often and addressing the feedback from you, the players!

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
We listen to our feedback and take customer suggestions very seriously! Thank you everyone for the comments, we truly appreciate every one of them.

We have just pushed an update which adds power-ups to the plasma turret and to the grenades, as well as giving you the ability to grenade distant missiles if you can. This can help "thin the herd" of inbound missiles, and make the melee more manageable.

Expect more updates in the coming days. And keep the suggestions coming! Inbound will not only be constantly improving for you but most importantly because of you!

-John Nagle
CTO
Gyoza Games
